title: Copilot moves to a budget.
stamp: Sent from my agent. Every claim checked.
checked_by: a second agent, independent of the writer

claims.where: dek
claims.claim: GitHub Enterprise now includes Copilot, metered from the first request; Copilot can drive desktop apps in preview; Google turned on a Gemini Notebook connection by default
claims.passage: AI usage is metered from the first request against your enterprise budget; Computer use—in public preview on macOS and Windows (github.blog Copilot app changelog); Gemini Notebook ON by default, OFF in the EEA…

claims.where: summary
claims.claim: Copilot comes with GitHub Enterprise, computer use in preview, Fusion routing, Gemini Notebook in Gemini, Vault exports of Gemini chats and cited Sheets fills
claims.passage: Each element confirmed against its vendor post below

claims.where: The story
claims.claim: Universe on Oct. 28 brought Copilot included with GitHub Enterprise, paid for from a usage budget rather than per-seat credits
claims.passage: October 28, 2026 (universe26 release) ... metered from the first request against your enterprise budget ... does not include monthly AI credits per seat

claims.where: The story
claims.claim: The same day GitHub put computer use for the Copilot app into public preview
claims.passage: October 28, 2026 ... Computer use—in public preview on macOS and Windows

claims.where: The story
claims.claim: and made Fusion, its model router, generally available
claims.passage: GitHub Copilot Fusion is generally available. ... let Copilot intelligently route and orchestrate which models it uses

claims.where: The story
claims.claim: Google switched on a Gemini Notebook connection inside the Gemini app by default outside the EEA
claims.passage: ON by default; OFF by default in the European Economic Area (post dated October 23, 2026)

claims.where: The story

claims.passage: Exports occur in JSON format and include user prompts, AI responses, and referenced file links (post dated October 22, 2026)
